One subcontractor. The whole internal and external finishing package.

From first-fix boarding to final skim, Camm Plastering runs the full package under one contract — gangs scaled to your build programme, materials called off to suit, and plots handed over ready for decoration.

We price labour-only or supply-and-fix, we say what we'll do and we do it. That's why housebuilders keep us on site after site.

Services

What we do

01

Plastering & skimming

Two-coat work and skim finishes across full plots, refurbishments and one-off rooms. Flat, snag-free walls and ceilings, ready for decoration — first time.

Hardwall & multi-finish · Re-skims over existing · Ceilings & Artex removal
02

Drylining & plasterboard

Dot and dab, metal stud partitions and full first-fix boarding packages. Tape and joint or skim finish to suit your specification and programme.

Dot & dab · Metal stud systems · Tape & joint · Acoustic & fire-rated boards
03

Rendering & external finishes

Traditional sand-and-cement and modern through-coloured render systems on new-build and refurbishment elevations, plus external wall insulation installs.

Through-coloured systems · Sand & cement · External wall insulation
